newsitem.title: UK: CRICKET-FOURTH TEST HIT BY RAIN.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-FOURTH TEST HIT BY RAIN.

text.p: England were 14 without loss after less than five overs were possible by tea because of rain in the fourth test between England and Australia at Headingley on Thursday.
England captain Michael Atherton was still to get off the mark after facing only one of the 29 balls bowled while fellow opener Mark Butcher was undefeated on nine.
Following an inspection, the umpires decided play would resume at 1545 GMT if there was no further rain.
Australian captain Mark Taylor sent England in to bat after winning the toss for the fourth time in the series.
The sides are level 1-1 in the six-match series.
